correctness.rationale: Explicit finite cyclic-gap enumeration gives L/n times compositions for the intact ring, (L-n)/L for original states vacant at the chosen site, and one unique additional oversized gap centered there. These imply an exact finite-size partition identity, whose strictly primitive simple dominant pole yields the thermodynamic ratio. The large-b root equation proves the logarithmic cubically suppressed exceptional probability. Reproduced by 1194 exact assertions in 16 exhaustively enumerated finite rings; checks complement rather than replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A single physically missing atom or permanently inactive site defines a natural boundary perturbation of a jammed lattice model. The theorem classifies every new gap enabled by that defect, computes the exact effect on the full fugacity partition function, and explains the nontrivial logarithmic cubically small probability of an otherwise impossible local configuration. This sharp all-b local law informs equilibrium stability and impurity response, beyond simple recomputation of pristine entropy or an arbitrary finite-slice invariant.
